name: notification-interactions
title: Notification interactions: click navigation + quota 100% actions & re-trigger semantics
description: Implemented 2026-10-09 from the finalized spec (see prd.md). Three gaps closed: (G1) click navigation — every local notification carries userInfo[route]; the app delegate's didReceive maps body clicks to openHistory(selecting: .alerts) / openSettings(selecting: .quota / .storage); both windows gained external selection handles (HistoryTabSelection mirrors SettingsTabSelection). (G2) the quota 100% notification carries the QUOTA_100 category with Acknowledge / Mute-1-hour / Mute-today actions (titles localized in all 21 tables; re-registered on locale change). (G3) quota 100% re-fires while usage grows past a persisted baseline by >= 1% of the quota, unless muted (1-hour mute in-memory; today-mute persisted in quota100MutedDay); 80%/custom stay once-per-period. 219 tests passing (13 new: pure-function + integration with a recording deliver stub). docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md documents the shipped behavior.
creator: Dawson
